instructions.title: Pie
items: Whisk pumpkin, sweetened condensed milk, eggs, spices and salt in medium bowl until smooth. Pour into crust.
Bake 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350°F; bake an additional 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted 1 inch from crust comes out clean.

instructions.title: Streusel topping (optional)
items: Combine brown sugar and flour in a medium bowl.
Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in chopped nuts.
After pie has baked 30 minutes, sprinkle over top and bake an additional 10 minutes.
